summary: English and Urdu first-party discovery identified PLRA/PULSE as the relevant provincial land-record and cadastral-map custodian. The live PULSE viewer exposes a Jhelum cadastral-map option and the PLRA-hosted Punjab cadastral ArcGIS service, but the service metadata and bounded exact-point query returned Token Required (499). No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response or GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, viewer configuration, token-required outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-7639-dina.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private token, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
